These are NOT automatically pies/feasts because BlockItem is edible. No second bake or minimum meal labour for native material shaping.

findings: Actual food constants retain SUGAR_RUSH suppliers even for architectural shapes. Cake-layer is RotatedPillarBlock with cake reassembly recipe, NOT CakeBlock bites; dough_block is distinct source edible material, NOT an approved KC-dough alias. Cookie blocks compact vanilla cookies; no new cookie-dough recipe is invented.
Source SUGAR_RUSH is BENEFICIAL and installs an attribute multiplier; retaining ingredient/utility roles never waives native positive-effect bounds or approves its contextual selection.

authored_review.reason: Exact AGAVE_BREAM registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/agave_bream.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=night, weather=clear; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact AMETHYSTBACK registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/amethystback.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares epic catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-40,-20 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact AQUAMARINE_PIKE registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/aquamarine_pike.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,0 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact AURORA registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/aurora.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares legendary catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact BIGEYE_TUNA registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/bigeye_tuna.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=night, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.

authored_review.reason: Exact BLACK_EEL registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/black_eel.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [0,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=False for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: NO source cooking/filleting applicability established: exact ID absent from source starcaught_fishes tag; do not add it or force a new preparation route

source_transform_tag_review.missing_interpretation: EXPLICIT SOURCE GAP: this exact raw fish is NOT in source cooking/fillet tag. No producing cooked/fillet route or alias approved for this ID; live datapack/provider contribution remains unknown.

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact BLOSSOMFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/blossomfish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=clear; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact BLUE_CRYSTAL_FIN registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/blue_crystal_fin.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=day, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact BLUE_HERRING registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/blue_herring.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=day, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact BLUEGIGI registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/bluegigi.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=day, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact BOREAL registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/boreal.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares legendary catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [100,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact BRIGHT_AMETHYST_SNAPPER registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/bright_amethyst_snapper.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares epic catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,0 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact CACTIFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/cactifish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=day, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact CARPENJOE registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/carpenjoe.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares epic catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.

Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact CHARFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/charfish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:the_end'], height [-2147483648,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact CHORUS_CRAB registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/chorus_crab.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares epic catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:the_end'], height [-2147483648,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=False for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: NO source cooking/filleting applicability established: exact ID absent from source starcaught_fishes tag; do not add it or force a new preparation route

source_transform_tag_review.missing_interpretation: EXPLICIT SOURCE GAP: this exact raw fish is NOT in source cooking/fillet tag. No producing cooked/fillet route or alias approved for this ID; live datapack/provider contribution remains unknown.

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

authored_review.reason: Exact DRIPFIN registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/dripfin.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [0,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.

authored_review.reason: Exact END_GLOW registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/end_glow.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:the_end'], height [-2147483648,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion

authored_review.reason: Exact GHOSTLY_PIKE registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/ghostly_pike.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,0 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact GLOWING_DARK registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/glowing_dark.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

authored_review.reason: Exact GOLD_FAN registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/gold_fan.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.
