authored_review.reason: Exact HOLLOWBELLY_DARTER registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/hollowbelly_darter.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [100,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

authored_review.reason: Exact IRONJAW_HERRING registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/ironjaw_herring.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

authored_review.reason: Exact JOEL registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/joel.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares legendary catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.
utility_review.source_food_properties_declaration: BASIC_RAW_FISH <clinit> offsets0..22: hunger-builder literal2, float modifier literal0.10000000149011612, symbolic builder flag m_38765_; no effect-supplier invocation in that construction. This is not an observed getter and no quantity field is approved.

Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=thunder; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

authored_review.reason: Exact LILY_SNAPPER registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/lily_snapper.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

authored_review.reason: Exact SANDTAIL registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/sandtail.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=night, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof

age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=clear; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [-2147483648,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof

Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

authored_review.reason: Exact SLUDGE_CATFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/sludge_catfish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares uncommon catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.

authored_review.reason: Exact SPOREFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/sporefish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

evidence.function: Exact named biome-tag contribution; no claim of complete current effective merged biome membership

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.

authored_review.reason: Exact STONEFISH registration and data/starcatcher/starcatcher/fish/stonefish.json identify a directly caught native raw-fish Item with BASIC_RAW_FISH, not a manufactured dish. Its own source declares common catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [0,50 inclusive, daytime=all, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

requirements: keep original species ID and finite old stock
do not force raw processing through protected meals
exact c:tools/knife remains in conditional shapeless fillet recipe, no forged FD cutting conversion
actual tools/remainders/wear/source count/NBT and4fillet yield need native proof
never reuse display grams, catch score or XP as edible portions/moisture
age/quality/provenance and current live tag/alternate closure remain native gates

source_acquisition.interpretation: Preserve exact whole resource. base_chance and correct_bait_chance_added are integer selection weights, NOT independent percentages. Correct bait boosts chance, is NOT asserted mandatory. Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.acquisition: native Starcatcher rod/bob/minigame; caught item/entity or actual bucket branch retained
source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.
source_apparatus_and_container.preparation: original furnace200/smoker100/campfire600 ticks; conditional Aquaculture shapeless knife+fish->4rawfillets, NOT an FD cutting-board recipe

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. Its own source declares rare catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [100,2147483647 inclusive, daytime=day, weather=all; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

Eligibility has live season-mod/config switches, DEV_WORM bypass and METEOROLOGICAL_BAIT weather bypass; actual bob/rod modifiers can override delivery. Fishing difficulty is acquisition, not synthetic culinary active-work credit. No acquisition removal/deletion/rate change authorized.

source_apparatus_and_container.containers: No recipe fluid/carrier volume asserted. Existing fish-bucket/water container is nonfood acquisition; never credit its contents as drink water or as a recipe bowl.

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Its own source declares epic catch category, dimensions ['minecraft:overworld'], height [50,100 inclusive, daytime=midnight, weather=rain; full remaining restrictions and minigame are retained below. Native raw input has source-tag applicability=True for the three heating recipes and conditional four-fillet transformation; absence is NOT repaired by species/name inference. Retain raw ingredient intake and finite stock with no added meal labour. Rarity, fishing minigame, display grams and magical naming establish neither cooked meal preparation nor consumptive utility exemption; do not alias this species to another raw fish.

utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

utility_review.held_utility_work: No source-proven consumed-potion utility necessitates protected preparation for this raw ingredient. Any newly observed external/stack-specific utility requires exact re-review, not a blanket rare-fish exemption.
utility_review.metadata: Original mixin strips SIZE_AND_WEIGHT and FISH_PROPERTIES on native same-item stack interaction. Keep original behavior distinguishable from new age/quality/provenance requirements; do not strip arbitrary NBT or add guessed nourishment/portions based on display weight.
utility_review.nonculinary_utility: Successful fishing calls FishCaughtCounter.awardFishCaughtCounter, TournamentHandler.addScore and native rarity.getXp award BEFORE physical delivery. Collection/tournament/XP and size/weight/FISH_PROPERTIES metadata belong to acquisition, not renewable eat-to-XP/potion effects. FishEntity setFish/getFishItem and m_28282_ preserve actual bucketed stack; FishItem.m_6225_ placement is CREATIVE-only. No survival fish-spawn, breeding or effect utility is invented.
utility_review.own_consumptive_effect_declarations: No MobEffect, LivingEntityUseItemEvent, FoodData or m_5922_ symbols in all348 own source classes. FishItem has no own finish/getFoodProperties override. This is a bounded negative source finding, NOT an observed empty awarded-effect array or proof against other mods.

findings: Actual cake item registration uses UNSTACKABLE_BLOCK_ITEM, not an Item.food builder. FoodProperties are stored by FoodCakeBlock for DIRECT block use/eatSlice; current item getter/intake cannot be inferred from that block declaration. Six block registrations and actual enum mapping/pinned Mantle naming helpers are preserved.

eatSlice requires player.canEat(false) OR source alwaysEat. BLOCK mode refuses if hasAllEffects finds every nonnull declared effect already present with duration>=100ticks (amplifier is not compared there). It awards cake stat, directly FoodData.eat(declared nutrition,modifier), server rolls each pair chance and adds a COPIED MobEffectInstance; return values ignored. Increments BITES while<6, then removes block. These source branches do NOT establish observed portions, successful effects or paid preparation→intake continuity.

Ender variant actually selects ADD, NOT BLOCK: for same effect AND same amplifier it adds old remaining duration to the fresh effect before addEffect; no hasAllEffects gate in ADD. Other variants select BLOCK, ichor specifically new InvertedCakeBlock with upper support/shape; source fast flag on ender FoodProperties does NOT imply item chewing or a culinary clock.

Actual source declared beneficial/harmful/neutral utility is real and may be renewable. Food effect constructor durations/chances are source only, not native selected doses, guaranteed teleport/safe gravity/XP/jumps or an admission exemption. Original bucket input multiplicity/remainders/grass or roots remain unchanged; no milk substitution or free carriers.

findings: Actual cake item registration uses UNSTACKABLE_BLOCK_ITEM, not an Item.food builder. FoodProperties are stored by FoodCakeBlock for DIRECT block use/eatSlice; current item getter/intake cannot be inferred from that block declaration. Six block registrations and actual enum mapping/pinned Mantle naming helpers are preserved.

eatSlice requires player.canEat(false) OR source alwaysEat. BLOCK mode refuses if hasAllEffects finds every nonnull declared effect already present with duration>=100ticks (amplifier is not compared there). It awards cake stat, directly FoodData.eat(declared nutrition,modifier), server rolls each pair chance and adds a COPIED MobEffectInstance; return values ignored. Increments BITES while<6, then removes block. These source branches do NOT establish observed portions, successful effects or paid preparation→intake continuity.

Ender variant actually selects ADD, NOT BLOCK: for same effect AND same amplifier it adds old remaining duration to the fresh effect before addEffect; no hasAllEffects gate in ADD. Other variants select BLOCK, ichor specifically new InvertedCakeBlock with upper support/shape; source fast flag on ender FoodProperties does NOT imply item chewing or a culinary clock.

Actual source declared beneficial/harmful/neutral utility is real and may be renewable. Food effect constructor durations/chances are source only, not native selected doses, guaranteed teleport/safe gravity/XP/jumps or an admission exemption. Original bucket input multiplicity/remainders/grass or roots remain unchanged; no milk substitution or free carriers.

findings: Exact table casting consumes ONE glass bottle +250 source-tagged fluid, cooling_time1→ONE bottle; whole Mantle transfer/support JSON and ingredients retained. Fixed supplier capability exposes250 Forge FluidStack amount from actual selected slime/venom fluid; these original API/recipe quantities are NOT measured hydration, intake dose, observed servings or successful paid conversion.

Own capability init ignores its CompoundTag argument locally and constructs ConstantFluidContainerWrapper from fixed supplier+stack. Wrapper cannot fill; drain requires matching fluid and at least full amount; only EXECUTE switches to empty remainder stack, returns a copy of fluid. Do NOT invent fractional sipping/drain, arbitrary item/fluid-NBT copying, fluid effect equivalence to eating, or current stack variant normalization.

Actual ContainerFoodItem finish saves original crafting remainder before base finish, then noncreative/nonplayer copy, empty return or player inventory/drop branches. Crafting remainder != capability drain result != observed consumption-carrier count; all native transactions/selected effects/age-quality remain OPEN.

Venom bottle food is DAMAGE_BOOST600 and POISON250 source declarations, NOT the separate registered tconstruct:venom status by name analogy. Ichor bottle is LEVITATION200 +MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN200amp1, NOT cake AntigravityEffect. Slime-specific source identity is not repaired into a single universal drink.

findings: Actual cake item registration uses UNSTACKABLE_BLOCK_ITEM, not an Item.food builder. FoodProperties are stored by FoodCakeBlock for DIRECT block use/eatSlice; current item getter/intake cannot be inferred from that block declaration. Six block registrations and actual enum mapping/pinned Mantle naming helpers are preserved.

eatSlice requires player.canEat(false) OR source alwaysEat. BLOCK mode refuses if hasAllEffects finds every nonnull declared effect already present with duration>=100ticks (amplifier is not compared there). It awards cake stat, directly FoodData.eat(declared nutrition,modifier), server rolls each pair chance and adds a COPIED MobEffectInstance; return values ignored. Increments BITES while<6, then removes block. These source branches do NOT establish observed portions, successful effects or paid preparation→intake continuity.

Ender variant actually selects ADD, NOT BLOCK: for same effect AND same amplifier it adds old remaining duration to the fresh effect before addEffect; no hasAllEffects gate in ADD. Other variants select BLOCK, ichor specifically new InvertedCakeBlock with upper support/shape; source fast flag on ender FoodProperties does NOT imply item chewing or a culinary clock.

Actual source declared beneficial/harmful/neutral utility is real and may be renewable. Food effect constructor durations/chances are source only, not native selected doses, guaranteed teleport/safe gravity/XP/jumps or an admission exemption. Original bucket input multiplicity/remainders/grass or roots remain unchanged; no milk substitution or free carriers.

Actual ContainerFoodItem finish saves original crafting remainder before base finish, then noncreative/nonplayer copy, empty return or player inventory/drop branches. Crafting remainder != capability drain result != observed consumption-carrier count; all native transactions/selected effects/age-quality remain OPEN.

Venom bottle food is DAMAGE_BOOST600 and POISON250 source declarations, NOT the separate registered tconstruct:venom status by name analogy. Ichor bottle is LEVITATION200 +MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN200amp1, NOT cake AntigravityEffect. Slime-specific source identity is not repaired into a single universal drink.

findings: Actual cake item registration uses UNSTACKABLE_BLOCK_ITEM, not an Item.food builder. FoodProperties are stored by FoodCakeBlock for DIRECT block use/eatSlice; current item getter/intake cannot be inferred from that block declaration. Six block registrations and actual enum mapping/pinned Mantle naming helpers are preserved.

eatSlice requires player.canEat(false) OR source alwaysEat. BLOCK mode refuses if hasAllEffects finds every nonnull declared effect already present with duration>=100ticks (amplifier is not compared there). It awards cake stat, directly FoodData.eat(declared nutrition,modifier), server rolls each pair chance and adds a COPIED MobEffectInstance; return values ignored. Increments BITES while<6, then removes block. These source branches do NOT establish observed portions, successful effects or paid preparation→intake continuity.

Ender variant actually selects ADD, NOT BLOCK: for same effect AND same amplifier it adds old remaining duration to the fresh effect before addEffect; no hasAllEffects gate in ADD. Other variants select BLOCK, ichor specifically new InvertedCakeBlock with upper support/shape; source fast flag on ender FoodProperties does NOT imply item chewing or a culinary clock.

Actual source declared beneficial/harmful/neutral utility is real and may be renewable. Food effect constructor durations/chances are source only, not native selected doses, guaranteed teleport/safe gravity/XP/jumps or an admission exemption. Original bucket input multiplicity/remainders/grass or roots remain unchanged; no milk substitution or free carriers.

findings: Actual cake item registration uses UNSTACKABLE_BLOCK_ITEM, not an Item.food builder. FoodProperties are stored by FoodCakeBlock for DIRECT block use/eatSlice; current item getter/intake cannot be inferred from that block declaration. Six block registrations and actual enum mapping/pinned Mantle naming helpers are preserved.

eatSlice requires player.canEat(false) OR source alwaysEat. BLOCK mode refuses if hasAllEffects finds every nonnull declared effect already present with duration>=100ticks (amplifier is not compared there). It awards cake stat, directly FoodData.eat(declared nutrition,modifier), server rolls each pair chance and adds a COPIED MobEffectInstance; return values ignored. Increments BITES while<6, then removes block. These source branches do NOT establish observed portions, successful effects or paid preparation→intake continuity.

Ender variant actually selects ADD, NOT BLOCK: for same effect AND same amplifier it adds old remaining duration to the fresh effect before addEffect; no hasAllEffects gate in ADD. Other variants select BLOCK, ichor specifically new InvertedCakeBlock with upper support/shape; source fast flag on ender FoodProperties does NOT imply item chewing or a culinary clock.

Actual source declared beneficial/harmful/neutral utility is real and may be renewable. Food effect constructor durations/chances are source only, not native selected doses, guaranteed teleport/safe gravity/XP/jumps or an admission exemption. Original bucket input multiplicity/remainders/grass or roots remain unchanged; no milk substitution or free carriers.

Fixed supplier capability exposes250 Forge FluidStack amount from actual selected slime/venom fluid; these original API/recipe quantities are NOT measured hydration, intake dose, observed servings or successful paid conversion.

Own capability init ignores its CompoundTag argument locally and constructs ConstantFluidContainerWrapper from fixed supplier+stack. Wrapper cannot fill; drain requires matching fluid and at least full amount; only EXECUTE switches to empty remainder stack, returns a copy of fluid. Do NOT invent fractional sipping/drain, arbitrary item/fluid-NBT copying, fluid effect equivalence to eating, or current stack variant normalization.

Actual ContainerFoodItem finish saves original crafting remainder before base finish, then noncreative/nonplayer copy, empty return or player inventory/drop branches. findings: Exact table casting consumes ONE glass bottle +250 source-tagged fluid, cooling_time1→ONE bottle; whole Mantle transfer/support JSON and ingredients retained. Fixed supplier capability exposes250 Forge FluidStack amount from actual selected slime/venom fluid; these original API/recipe quantities are NOT measured hydration, intake dose, observed servings or successful paid conversion.

Own capability init ignores its CompoundTag argument locally and constructs ConstantFluidContainerWrapper from fixed supplier+stack. Wrapper cannot fill; drain requires matching fluid and at least full amount; only EXECUTE switches to empty remainder stack, returns a copy of fluid. Do NOT invent fractional sipping/drain, arbitrary item/fluid-NBT copying, fluid effect equivalence to eating, or current stack variant normalization.

Actual ContainerFoodItem finish saves original crafting remainder before base finish, then noncreative/nonplayer copy, empty return or player inventory/drop branches. Crafting remainder != capability drain result != observed consumption-carrier count; all native transactions/selected effects/age-quality remain OPEN.

Venom bottle food is DAMAGE_BOOST600 and POISON250 source declarations, NOT the separate registered tconstruct:venom status by name analogy. Ichor bottle is LEVITATION200 +MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN200amp1, NOT cake AntigravityEffect. Slime-specific source identity is not repaired into a single universal drink.
